parameters.command: cd /opt/content-engine && git add industries/chiropractic/brand-voice && git commit -m 'weekly: refresh voice doc' && git push || echo 'no changes'

_readme.purpose: Weekly Studio agentic chain — Sunday 8pm AEST. Refreshes the Living Brand Voice, gathers performance + intel signals, synthesizes 10 audience-tagged idea cards, bulk-seeds the inbox, commits the voice doc to git, sends a Telegram completion message.
import_steps: 1. In your n8n instance, Workflows → Import from File → select this JSON
2. Add the following environment variables to your n8n instance:
- DASHBOARD_URL (e.g. https://dashboard.your-domain.com or http://localhost:3001 if tunneled)
3. Adjust the executeCommand paths (currently /opt/content-engine — point at wherever the repo is checked out on the n8n host)
4. Save the workflow's Manual Trigger Webhook URL; paste into packages/dashboard/.env as N8N_WEEKLY_STUDIO_WEBHOOK_URL so the dashboard 'Run Studio' button can fire it off-schedule
_readme.manual_trigger: Two entry points: the Sunday 8pm cron OR a POST to the workflow webhook (URL: {{n8n_host}}/webhook/weekly-studio). The dashboard 'Run Studio' button posts to the latter via /api/studio/run-now.
